set.subject: reasoning
set.title: Box puzzle
set.stimulus:
Eight boxes — A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H — are kept one above another in a single stack, but not necessarily in the same order. The bottommost position is numbered 1 and the topmost position is numbered 8. Each box contains a different item — Caps, Lamps, Cups, Candles, Bottles, Pens, Books and Watches.

1. Only two boxes are kept between the box containing Caps and box H.
2. Box B contains Books.
3. Only one box is kept between the box containing Candles and the box containing Bottles, and the box containing Candles is kept above the box containing Bottles.
4. Less than four boxes are kept between the box containing Books and the box containing Watches.
5. Box D is kept above box F.
6. Only two boxes are kept above box A.
7. The box containing Pens is not kept immediately above or immediately below box G.
8. As many boxes are kept below box D as above box C.
9. Box G contains Caps.
10. Less than five boxes are kept below the box containing Caps.
11. Only four boxes are kept between the box containing Cups and the box containing Pens.
12. As many boxes are kept below the box containing Bottles as above box C.

Clue 2 → the box containing Books at position 3; Box E takes the only place left: position 4.

Case the box containing Pens at position 7: clue 11 cannot be satisfied — rejected.
Case the box containing Pens at position 8: clue 11 cannot be satisfied — rejected.

Continuing the same way, the remaining clues fix everyone.

Eight boxes — P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W — are kept one above another in a single stack, but not necessarily in the same order. The bottommost position is numbered 1 and the topmost position is numbered 8. Each box contains a different item — Candles, Lamps, Toys, Watches, Bags, Books, Pens and Bottles.

1. Box R contains Bags.
2. Box W contains Watches.
3. As many boxes are kept below box R as above box V.
4. At least one box is kept between the box containing Bottles and box U.
5. More than two boxes are kept below the box containing Candles.
6. Only one box is kept between the box containing Books and the box containing Pens.
7. As many boxes are kept below box T as above box W.
8. As many boxes are kept between box U and the box containing Candles as between the box containing Candles and box R.
9. Box Q is not kept at an even-numbered position.
10. More than five boxes are kept above box U.
11. Only four boxes are kept between box P and the box containing Toys.
12. Box P contains Pens.
13. The box containing Watches is kept above the box containing Toys.
